unit_of_observation: One reviewed regulator-issued decision about a data breach or associated data-security failure
source_threshold: Selected official data-breach and security decisions. Marketing, cookie and unrelated privacy cases are excluded.
source_population: Organisations named by the regulator in the selected publications.
public_window: A reviewed selection of dated official decisions, not an exhaustive or continuously discovered enforcement register.
correction_process: Review the linked official publication and any later appeal or amended decision before changing the curated event. Publication dates and decision dates remain separate.
limitations: The selection is not exhaustive and does not measure enforcement activity across countries.
An administrative fine is a regulator decision, not a court judgment.
The event does not establish payment, finality on appeal or the absence of later proceedings.
Organisation names identify the regulator's respondent; they do not establish that every named entity is a breached data controller.
name: ICO selected data-breach regulatory actions
